documents.title: Device cannot connect to network
documents.content:
The device is unable to establish a network connection.

Possible causes:
- Wi-Fi is unavailable
- Network credentials are incorrect
- The device is outside the network range

Resolution:
- Check that Wi-Fi is enabled
- Verify the network credentials
- Move the device closer to the network
- Retry the connection

Related documents:
- E456

documents.title: Authentication failed
documents.content:
The device could not authenticate with the configured service.

Possible causes:
- Invalid credentials
- Expired authentication session

Resolution:
- Verify the credentials
- Sign in again
- Retry the operation

Related documents:
- E123

documents.title: Device communication timeout
documents.content:
The device did not respond within the expected time.

Possible causes:
- Device is offline
- Network latency
- Temporary communication failure

Resolution:
- Check device connectivity
- Retry the operation
- Restart the device if necessary

Related documents:
- E123
